第1章进入地球
乌云密布的天空，仿佛火烧一样的大地，充满硫磺味的空气，这里，就是传说中的地狱。
一个黑发身影坐在一个黑曜石打造的王座上，在他身前，一个泥土小矮人用力跳起撞向上方的黑石，黑石在音效声中冒出一朵蘑菇。
接着，蘑菇从黑石上掉下，小矮人上前吞掉，眨眨眼的功夫，它就变成一个大矮人。
“好无聊啊。”
人影叹了一口气，一挥手，无论是小矮人，还是前方的超级玛丽场景全部化成灰消散。
此人名叫王南轩，是这方新地狱的主人。
“人家穿越我也穿越，却穿越到一个连虫子都没有的新地狱，我怎么这么倒霉啊？”
王南轩唉声叹气，这方地狱他拥有绝对的控制权，问题是，除了他以外，没有其他生命，一开始，他还有点兴奋，但一年后，他剩下的只有孤独和狂躁。
摇了摇头，王南轩的双眼穿透虚空，望向上方的维度，那里有一颗充满生机的星球。
这颗星球与这方地狱有一种神秘的联系，王南轩很想进入这颗星球，问题是，他进不去——这颗星球外面有一层由三个节点组成的金色防御罩。
王南轩曾经派投影想降临那颗星球，结果，还没靠近，投影就被一道金色的魔法鞭抽碎，之后，他尝试过许多办法，但没一个成功。
很明显，那颗星球里，有一个超级守护者，连地狱领主都要忌惮的超级守护者。
“这三个节点，越看越觉得像电网标志，我究竟穿越到了哪里？”
王南轩靠在椅子上，一脸绝望，再这样下去，他说不定会疯掉，更糟糕的是，他想自杀都不行——除非这方地狱毁灭，否则，他这个地狱领主永远不死。
“嗯？”
就在这时，王南轩注意到有一道黑影正在悄悄靠近那颗星球，他身上有一层奇特的黑暗能量，守护法阵没有发现他。
王南轩眼睛一亮，立刻放出投影无声无息的靠近那黑影，附在对方衣服上。
黑影实力远不如王南轩这个地狱领主，所以他什么都没发现，他悄悄来到星球外面，利用身上的黑暗能量将防御罩溶解出一个小小的洞，接着，他偷偷潜入星球。
“机会来了。”

王南轩大喜，因为那个洞实在太狭小，为了保证能穿过去，他将九成力量化成一个诅咒融入黑影身体，只剩下一成继续附在黑影衣服上。
很快，黑影彻底进入星球，紧接着，防御罩恢复正常。
王南轩吐出一口气，喃喃自语道：“进去了，无论如何，投影要留在那颗星球，否则，我真的会无聊死。”
……
得州，乌云密布，雷霆闪烁的黑夜里，一道身影带着火焰出现大地之上，他哈哈大笑道：“哈哈，我黑心魔进入地球了，老头子，你等着，等我找到圣凡冈萨契约，无论是地球，还是地狱，都将属于我。”
这道身影，穿着身黑色长大衣，面色苍白，一脸邪恶，是地狱领主墨菲斯托的儿子，黑心魔。
“黑心魔？地狱魔王墨菲斯托之子？”
content_en:
Chapter 1 Entering the Earth
The sky is covered with dark clouds, the earth is on fire, and the air is filled with the smell of sulfur. This is the legendary hell.
A black-haired figure sat on a throne made of obsidian. In front of him, a small clay dwarf jumped up and hit the black stone above. A mushroom sprouted from the black stone amidst the sound effects.
Then, the mushroom fell from the black stone, and the dwarf stepped forward to swallow it. In the blink of an eye, it turned into a big dwarf.
"So boring."
The figure sighed and waved his hand, and both the dwarf and the Super Mario scene in front of him turned into ashes and disappeared.
This person's name is Wang Nanxuan, and he is the master of this new hell.
"I also traveled through time when others traveled through time, but I ended up traveling through time to a new hell where there are no bugs. Why am I so unlucky?"
Wang Nanxuan sighed. He had absolute control over this hell. The problem was that there was no other life except him. At first, he was a little excited, but a year later, all he had left was loneliness and mania.
Shaking his head, Wang Nanxuan's eyes penetrated the void and looked to the dimension above, where there was a planet full of life.
There is a mysterious connection between this planet and this hell. Wang Nanxuan really wants to enter this planet, but the problem is that he can't - there is a golden defense shield composed of three nodes outside the planet.
Wang Nanxuan once sent a projection to land on the planet, but before he could get close, the projection was shattered by a golden magic whip. After that, he tried many methods, but none of them succeeded.
Obviously, there is a super guardian on that planet, a super guardian that even the lord of hell is afraid of.
"These three nodes, the more I look at them, the more they look like the symbols of a power grid. Where did I travel to?"
Wang Nanxuan leaned on the chair with a look of despair. If he continued like this, he might go crazy. What's worse, he couldn't even commit suicide - unless this hell was destroyed, he, the lord of hell, would never die.
"Huh?"
At this moment, Wang Nanxuan noticed a black shadow quietly approaching the planet. He had a layer of strange dark energy on his body, and the guardian circle did not detect him.
Wang Nanxuan's eyes lit up, and he immediately released a projection that silently approached the black shadow and attached it to the other person's clothes.
Black Shadow's strength was far inferior to Wang Nanxuan, the lord of hell, so he didn't notice anything. He quietly came outside the planet and used the dark energy in his body to dissolve the defensive shield to create a small hole. Then, he sneaked into the planet secretly.
"The opportunity has come."
Wang Nanxuan was overjoyed because the hole was too small. In order to ensure that he could pass through it, he turned 90% of his power into a curse and integrated it into the black shadow's body, leaving only 10% to remain attached to the black shadow's clothes.
Soon, the black shadow completely entered the planet, and then the defensive shield returned to normal.
Wang Nanxuan exhaled and murmured to himself: "Going in, no matter what, the projection must stay on that planet, otherwise, I will really die of boredom."
…
In Texas, in the dark night with dark clouds and flashing thunder, a figure appeared on the earth with flames. He laughed loudly and said: "Haha, my black-hearted demon has entered the earth. Old man, you wait, when I find the Saint Fangansa contract, whether it is the earth or hell, it will belong to me."
This figure, wearing a long black coat, with a pale face and an evil look, is the son of Hell Lord Mephisto, the Black-Hearted Demon.
"The Black Heart Demon? The son of Hell Demon Mephisto?"
